The '''Crystal Ridge''' was a ridge located on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystal Ridge is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "War Crimes" on Alderaan.
